title: Host-Orchestrated Agent Skill Over Standalone LLM CLI
decision: Package PreFlight as a native Agent Skill (SKILL.md + deterministic Python helper scripts) orchestrated by the host agent.
rejected: Standalone Python CLI loop calling gemini-2.5-flash directly.
rationale: Avoids duplicate API keys and split context while keeping GitHub API caching and HTML rendering deterministic.

title: Hybrid Repo-Native Markdown/JSON State and SQLite Repo Cache
decision: Store Working State and Decision Ledger as git-diffable JSON/Markdown (.preflight/*.json, docs/adr/*.md) and use SQLite (.preflight/cache.db) strictly for Tier 3 GitHub API caching.
rejected: Single opaque SQLite database for all three memory tiers.
rationale: Downstream coding agents and humans need direct access to docs/adr/ and GLOSSARY.md in version control.
